Rotom and the Girl!'') is the second chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== {{spoilers}} * The {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s report to [[Guzma]] about their loss to {{adv|Sun}}. * Guzma tells the Grunts to bring Sun to him so he can teach the boy a lesson personally. * Sun sets out to take {{adv|Moon}} and {{TP|Moon|Rotom}} to [[Professor Kukui]] as part of his delivery. * Moon reveals that she is a pharmacist and a skilled archer. * Sun and Moon meet the [[Guardian deities|guardian deity]] of [[Melemele Island]], {{p|Tapu Koko}}, who attacks them. * After a brief battle with Sun, Tapu Koko flees, leaving behind a [[Sparkling Stone]]. * Sun and Moon arrive at Professor Kukui's laboratory. * The [[island kahuna]]s reveal that the guardian deities have been angered, and begin planning on how to appease them. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== * [[Guzma]] * [[Professor Kukui]] * [[Hala]] * [[Olivia]] * [[Nanu]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Comfey}} * {{p|Pikipek}} * {{p|Tapu Koko}} * {{p|Rowlet}} * {{p|Popplio}} * {{p|Tapu Lele}} * {{p|Tapu Bulu}} * {{p|Tapu Fini}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Sun}} * {{adv|Moon}} * [[Professor Kukui]] * [[Hala]] * [[Olivia]] * [[Nanu]] * [[Guzma]] * {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Meowth}} ([[Cent]];
